Subject: Request: Additional trial credits for batch POC (throughput validation)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the ScalioTech team had good questions around latency under sustained parallel requests. As discussed, you're planning a 48-hour POC to validate throughput and tail latencies for a batch-processing job that will simulate concurrent inference across 300 workers.

Quick ask: can we provide an additional trial credit top-up so your QA team can run the full load profile (estimated ~150k tokens/day over 2 days)?

I've attached our proposed test plan and the minimal token estimates. If you confirm the exact QPS target (peak & sustained) we'll allocate the credits and pin a temporary rate-limit policy to avoid noisy neighbors.

Attached: poc-load-plan.xlsx (test schedule & token math)

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm peak/sustained QPS and list of endpoints to hit
- We provision a promo credit bundle and a temporary routing policy
- Post-POC we'll review results and talk Dedicated sizing if you want to continue at scale

CC'ing Monica from our Solutions team — she'll help coordinate the test windows.

Thanks,
Rafael

rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Rafael,

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Our QA lead wants to confirm a few items before you allocate credits:

- Target sustained QPS: 250 req/s for 2 hours windows, then sustained 80 req/s for the remainder.
- Peak concurrent workers: 300 (as you noted).
- Test endpoints: /generate-chat and /embed-batch (we'll supply exact payloads tomorrow).

Procurement is looped for internal tracking (they require a short SOW for any promotional allocation). Can you provide a one-line SOW or a link to the HubSpot record where this will be logged? Also want to ensure any temporary rate limits won't affect our latency characterization.

Alex
